clips.title: The story
paras: Atop the central Stonetalon peaks, Sun Rock Retreat shelters the Horde south of Mirkfallon Lake. Tauren hold the mountain sacred, while orcs and tauren use the settlement as a base and supply post.

Sun Rock Retreat lies in a mountain basin south of Mirkfallon Lake, on ground the tauren have long held sacred. Ancient tradition says An'she, the Sun, kissed the peak above the village. For generations before the Horde came, tauren shamans and pilgrims traveled here for rites that crossed the mortal veil. They drew strength from the land's close bond with the spirit world.

Orcs and tauren now hold Sun Rock Retreat as the Horde's chief base across the Stonetalon Mountains. Together they seek a secure foothold against hostile harpy broods, local night elf sentinels, and the Venture Company's industrial pillaging. Trade and flight routes link the retreat with Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and the borders of Ashenvale. The outpost offers shelter, provisions, and spiritual guidance to those who brave the crags.
